content:
sara: spotted a plaintext GCP SA key id in staging partner webhook logs. payload also included a wrapped_blob ref. redacting and triaging now.

tom: where exactly? paste safe grep and vault path (no secrets).

sara: logs-staging:/var/log/webhook/partner/* matched entries with `service_account: partner-ingest@...` and `wrapped_blob: partner-wrap:v3`. vault consumer path: secret/data/partner/ingest.

infra: containment: 1) pause staging consumer 2) snapshot vault metadata 3) request partner rotate+revoke 4) rewrap ciphertext and restrict RBAC. who can run vault ops?

tom: I got vault. will dry-run transit rewrap then apply. commands (dry-run first):
```\nvault kv get -format=json secret/data/partner/ingest > /tmp/partner.meta
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key partner-wrap:v3 --dry-run
```\n
devsec-bot: alert created SEC-4921 and attached evidence.

vault-bot: audit: request/response logging on secret/data/partner enabled at 2026-06-10T18:22:01Z.

sara: paused webhook-ingest-staging. partner notified, asked to rotate within 30m and provide proof.

tom: dry-run OK, executing rewrap -> new ciphertext partner-wrap:v4. updated KV to point to new id and redeployed consumer. QA passed locally.

infra: rotating our staging SA keys and adding IP allowlist for ingestion endpoint. ETA 30m.

sara: follow-ups: update onboarding docs to forbid plaintext keys, add presubmit linter for payloads, RBAC audit for partner identities, postmortem in SEC-4921.

tom: dropping rewrap logs to SEC-4921. marking vault ops done.

sara: leaving ticket open until partner proof + our key rotation confirmed. thanks all. :lock:
